title: NASA people study the phenomenon and travel with him

tellings.quote: Yeah. We love them. And uh but there are a lot of other NASA guys that I'm currently talking with.

plain: People from NASA, the US space agency, study the strange events around him and travel with him, says Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him. Speaking of his own life since about 2007, he names two men he works with, Hal Pavvenmeer and Timothy Taylor, and says, "there are a lot of other NASA guys that I'm currently talking with." If true, it would mean people at the space agency take his experiences seriously enough to follow them up.
